observability_triage.rationale: Word content controls serialize their stable identity and displayed label in w:sdtPr and their initial instruction in w:sdtContent. A validator can compare those values and can replace only w:sdtContent in a temporary copy to prove the original-purpose metadata remains after user text changes.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every interactive Word content control has a unique non-empty w:tag and a non-empty w:alias label exactly matching the normalized instruction initially visible inside that control.

setup: Build dist/template.docx in a fresh workspace.

expected_observations.subject: interactive w:sdt nodes missing a non-empty w:tag
interactive controls whose normalized w:alias differs from initial visible w:sdtContent instruction

determinism_controls: Classify interactive controls from their OOXML control type, not from application source declarations.
Normalize XML whitespace only; preserve case and punctuation in the equality comparison.

setup: One content control has alias 'Add date' but initially displays 'Choose date'.
negative_cases.action: Compare normalized alias and initial visible content.
negative_cases.expected_failure_or_absence: The criterion fails for that control.

acceptance_criteria.statement: After visible content of each interactive control is replaced with fixture user text, the saved DOCX retains the original non-empty alias/help label associated with the same unique tag, so Word can expose the original purpose independently of the replacement text.

setup: Copy the built DOCX to a temporary path.
Record each interactive control's tag and alias.

parameters.mutation: replace only descendant visible text in each w:sdtContent with deterministic fixture text

expected_observations.subject: controls whose replacement content equals their retained alias

determinism_controls: Mutate a temporary copy only and use the unique w:tag as the join key.
Do not accept customXml prose as a substitute for w:sdtPr metadata.

setup: Replacing control text also overwrites or removes its alias.
negative_cases.action: Compare tag-to-alias maps before and after replacement.
negative_cases.expected_failure_or_absence: The criterion fails because the original purpose is no longer retained independently.
